description.message: Send the page you are reading to TextFold on this computer, as you see it, and read it at five levels.

saved_closed.message: In your TextFold library. Open TextFold to read it.

err_notext.message: TextFold found too little text to read on this page.

err_notweb.message: TextFold reads web pages (http and https) only.

err_nopage.message: This page could not be read.

err_update.message: TextFold needs an update. See the tab that opened.

err_setup.message: TextFold is not connected. See the tab that opened.

ok_text.message: TextFold $VERSION$ answers. Click the TextFold button on any page you are reading to send it there.

missing_text.message: The button hands each page to TextFold, a free app on this computer. Set it up once:

forbidden_title.message: TextFold does not let this extension in yet

forbidden_text.message: The TextFold on this computer is older than this extension. Update it:

exited_text.message: It may have been moved or removed since it was last opened. Then:

update_text.message: This extension is newer than the TextFold on this computer. Update it:

step_download.message: Download TextFold for macOS or Windows and install it.

step_update.message: Download the newest TextFold and install it over the old one.

step_open.message: Open TextFold once. It connects itself to this browser.

step_again.message: Come back to the page and click the TextFold button again.

pip_text.message: Install or update it, then let this browser reach it, once:

privacy_note.message: The extension hands the page to TextFold on this computer and to nothing else. TextFold writes its levels with the model you chose in its settings.
